fusions.name: Ram From the Ledge
fusions.desc: Rushes you to a target up to 7 tiles away, then butts it for 14 damage and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Scree Spray
fusions.desc: Kicks loose scree in a cone ahead of you, dealing 7 damage to everything caught in it. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 25%). Holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Planted Mid-Stride
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 25% for 8 seconds. You move 20% faster for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Shrugs and Climbs
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 4. At 4 they all spend at once: you move and attack 5% faster per stack (18% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 8 seconds.
